inheritance: The v1 one-shot winner NULL_COUPLED remains frozen as the scalar-target structural-sufficiency winner. All field, Japan38 history, colour stop-rule and absolute-time gates remain in force.

v3_scalar_target_result.meaning: best structural sufficiency among the 14 preregistered families for the frozen 62 scalar observational estimands
v3_scalar_target_result.not_meaning: no environmental biology, no adaptation, no selection, no plasticity, and not common evolutionary lability

v3_held_out_support_validation.interpretation: The snapshot NULL_COUPLED family is sufficient for the frozen raw scalar target bundle but is not sufficient for the held-out replication-stable inferential-support geometry. The scale-specific among-taxon process-support pattern therefore contains information not captured by the frozen snapshot-null generator.
v3_held_out_support_validation.stop_rule: Do not rerank v1, increase the 64 held-out draws, change 99 permutations, redefine the primary support pattern, or add held-out support back into the v1 score.

next_scientific_gate.question: What minimal additional structure can reproduce the held-out among-taxon process-support geometry without refitting the frozen v1 scalar target ranking?
next_scientific_gate.allowed_direction: A separately versioned falsification follow-up may compare predeclared additions such as explicit among-taxon process structure against the frozen NULL_COUPLED baseline using the held-out support geometry as its own endpoint.
next_scientific_gate.prohibited_direction: Do not use the held-out result to retroactively tune or rescue the v1 one-shot ranking.
